_readme: Schema example for editorial/managers.json, which is gitignored because it carries real Sleeper handles and identity data (repo hygiene rule from the my-writing-style skill: real names/handles stay out of committed files; league nicknames and team names are fine). Regenerate the real file with scripts/seed_editorial.py after a sync, then hand-curate. Alias statuses: entries in 'aliases' are confirmed; 'unverified_aliases' entries are inferred (never usable as fact) or rejected (kept so they are not re-inferred). Set 'allow_cross_league_callbacks': true on a manager ONLY when Jonathan explicitly marks their history as usable across leagues.

unverified_aliases.name: MaybeNickname
unverified_aliases.rule: Do not use in generated copy until confirmed.
